§6Environmental Controller§f

§aBeacon on steroids, apply potion effects, flight, and peace over a massive radius.§f

The §bEnvironmental Controller§f broadcasts passive status effects to everyone in range. §e500,000 RF§f buffer, §e20,000 RF/t§f input. Inserts a §bRange Module§f (tiers 1-3) to set the radius.

§6Modules§f (cost scales with radius volume):
§b• Flight§f: Creative flight, §e0.004 RF/t per block§f
§b• Regeneration§f: §e0.0015 RF/t per block§f (Plus: §e0.0045§f)
§b• Saturation§f: No hunger, §e0.001 RF/t per block§f
§b• Speed / Haste§f: §e0.001 RF/t per block§f each
§b• Night Vision§f: §e0.001 RF/t per block§f
§b• Peaceful§f: Prevents hostile spawns, §e0.001 RF/t per block§f

Toggle §bMob Multiplier§f to affect mobs too (§c2.0× power cost§f).

§9Note:§f Poison, Blindness, and Weakness modules are disabled in this pack. They can only target mobs, not players.
